Intel: chunk multi-function Python source into multiple pieces

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using TreeSitterLanguagePack;

var result = TreeSitterLanguagePackConverter.Process("def alpha():\n    pass\n\ndef beta():\n    pass\n\ndef gamma():\n    pass\n\ndef delta():\n    pass\n", new ProcessConfig { ChunkMaxSize = 30, Language = "python" });
Console.WriteLine(result.Language);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metrics.TotalLines);
Console.WriteLine(result.Chunks);
```
